rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who has recently arrived in a community or place.

example.traditional: 呢個新嚟嘅人係我鄰居。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 lei4 ge3 jan4 hai6 ngo5 leon4 geoi1

rows.note: Use this for a beginner or inexperienced new participant in an activity.

example.english: I'm a newcomer, so please go easy on me.
example.traditional: 我係新手，請大家多多指教。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 san1 sau2 cing2 daai6 gaa1 do1 do1 zi2 gaau3

rows.note: Use this for a newcomer who has just joined a team, organization, workplace, or other group, rather than simply someone who has recently arrived.

example.english: The company hired one newcomer this month.
example.traditional: 公司今個月請咗一個新人。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gam1 go3 jyut6 cing2 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 jan4
